# sustain_service (Data Source)

A service the workspace has, by its id or its name: what other resources name it by.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A service made in the console, by its name, so a service made here can depend on it.
data "sustain_service" "payments" {
  name = "Payments"
}

resource "sustain_service" "checkout" {
  name           = "Checkout"
  dependency_ids = [data.sustain_service.payments.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Its id: given, or found by its name.
- `name` (String) Its name, exactly as the workspace has it, which only it may have: given, or read by its id.
